text_block_list.text:
When I walk past the hollowed-out
stump, I
notice two items next to it that
look about three
times bigger than what
they should be.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Is that a mortar and pestle?!

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ I'm about to make some mochi!
My
dormmates have been asking for
some.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Well, I figured I could make a bigger
batch with
bigger tools. I want everyone
to have their fill and
then some! ☆
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
I can make everyone happy with my
buono mochi!
The bigger the better as
they say!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Akebono! The rice is done!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Great! Time to get started, then!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Акэбоно takes the enormous
pestle and
begins to make mochi with
some other
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Heeeaaave!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Hooooo!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Pheeeeew! This thing's pretty heavy!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a quick break?
You must be putting a lot of strength into that.

text_block_list.text: Pheeeeew! This thing's pretty heavy!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
choice_data_list: Why don't you take a quick break?
You must be putting a lot of strength into that.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's a good idea. I wanna have a
nibble
of the mochi anyways. ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, you guys over there! Do you
want some
mochi too? It's piping hot
and ready to eat! ☆
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
What? You made mochi?! Can I really
have some?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Of course! Have as much as you'd like!
Get 'em
while they're warm! ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, back to you! What do you want
on your
mochi? We've got soy sauce and
grated radish! ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! We're gonna make loads
more
anyway, so don't hold back! ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, it's not so much my strength but
my
weight that I'm throwing into this...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Using your weight to pound mochi
makes it more
chewy and tasty!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty big, so consider this technique
my
specialty!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
choice_data_list: I see. What a good technique!

text_block_list.text:
Right? Like I always say, the bigger the
better! ☆
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
The "sample" I get is about the size of
my head,
but Хиши Акэбоно's mochi
really is delicious.
Everyone smiles
brightly as we eat together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The mochi Хиши Акэбоно makes with
her unique
technique has an incredible
springiness and is
extremely delicious!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
